school.name: Cyberarts Studio Academy
school.overview:
Cyberarts Studio Academy is a small high school located on John Jay Campus in Park Slope, Brooklyn NY.  The student body consists of: 32% Black; 51% Hispanic; 8% White; 5% Asian; 4% Other.  

We pride ourselves on studentsÃ¢ÂÂ academic and social emotional growth by developing opportunities for students to meet in small groups and other restorative justice practices.  Students participate in National Honor Society (NHS) and student government where students give back to the community and have a shared voice in school goals. Cyberarts Studio Academy offers a variety of Advanced Placement and cyberarts courses such as  AP English Language and Composition, AP English Literature and Composition, AP Art and Design, AP Spanish Language and Culture, AP human Geography, AP Black History, AP Psychology, AP Computer Science Principles, and AP Environmental Science. Our cyberarts courses consist of Digital Media, Graphic Design, Computer Science, film, digital photography, and digital music.  

For the 2024-2025 school year, CASA will partner with CISCO to offer our students elective courses in Cybersecurity. Students will be immersed in courses such as: Data Science, Computer Hardware Basics, IT Essentials, Introduction to Digital Transformation, etc. Additionally, our students will be able to graduate up with up to 9 college credits due to our dual credit partnership with St. Francis College. Our students are able to participate in PE swim classes and take Drivers Ed elective.
Cyberarts Studio Academy partners with the following community based organizations: BRIC Arts Media; Big Brothers, Big Sisters; Project Reach Youth (PRY); and Brain Power Wellness to provide support with studentsÃ¢ÂÂ academic and social development.
We also offer a variety of PSAL varsity and Junior varsity sports.  Sports being offered include: Boys and Girls Cross Country; Boys and Girls Fencing; Boys and Girls Varsity Soccer; Boys and Girls Swimming, Girls Junior Varsity and Varsity Volleyball; Boys JV and Varsity Baseball; Girls JV and Varsity Softball; Boys Jr. Varsity and Varsity Basketball; Boys and Girls Indoor Track; Boys and Girls Table Tennis; Girls JV and Varsity Basketball; Coed Stunt; Girls Flag Football. We are part of the Career Readiness and Modern Youth Apprenticeship (CRMYA) pilot, which helps us support career readiness for all our students. We have courses that help our ninth and tenth graders explore their career interests and develop readiness skills. Our students can apply for apprenticeships in tech, finance, and business, which allows them to earn and learn while in high school.

programs.name: CYBERaRTS Studio Academy (K29A)
programs.description: The CYBERaRTS Studio Academy integrates vigorous STEM, Design Thinking and liberal arts courses to educate talented artist, media specialist, scientists, engineers, and mathematicians--inspiring them to become passionate problem-solvers who understand the impact of their work on society. We believe technology divorced from humanity is worse than no technology at all.
